description: Browse saved notes newest first, with short previews and ids, when you have no query. Page with limit and offset; filter with written_by and not_written_by. Replaced notes are hidden unless include_replaced=true. Read-only.

detail.description: "full": every field and up to 600 body characters per note.

include_replaced.description: Also list notes that a newer note has replaced.

not_written_by.description: Leave out notes written by this writer.

offset.description: How many notes to skip, to reach the next page.

written_by.description: Only notes written by this writer.

name: memory_list
title: List notes
